evidence.snippet: We introduce Multi-Legal-Bench, the first cross-jurisdictional legal benchmark that evaluates identical tasks across six countries (Ukraine, France, Netherlands, Poland, Czech Republic, Lithuania), four language families, and 165 million full-text court decisions.

claire_radar.motivation: Legal NLP benchmarks overwhelmingly evaluate a single language or aggregate tasks that differ fundamentally across jurisdictions, making cross-lingual comparison impossible.

source.title: Multi-Legal-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Legal Reasoning Across Jurisdictions, Languages, and Legal Traditions

claire_radar.whyItMatters: It enables cross-lingual and cross-jurisdictional comparison of legal reasoning, revealing that transfer quality depends more on label-set alignment than language proximity, aiding model selection in legal NLP.
